zh-CN.title: Chronelle 日历插件
items: 时序插件使用官方图标并新增介绍弹窗，移除应用与插件页面的额外底色
支持绑定和解绑 Chronelle 公开日历，并在个人名片中直接查看日程
菜单新增应用和插件分类，基础信息支持以好友或陌生人视角预览我的名片
修复链接卡片跳转丢失页面内路由的问题，并补充复制成功提示

en.title: Chronelle calendar plugin
items: Chronelle uses its official icon and an introduction dialog; removed the extra apps and plugins background
Bind or unbind a public Chronelle calendar and display its schedule on your profile card
Browse apps and plugins in separate tabs and preview your profile card from a friend or stranger perspective
Link cards preserve hash routes and copying messages or links shows a success notification
